user_intention: 同样时间内学得更强、更稳定；主动寻找其他候选，不再等待B停滞门槛才诊断。
source_policy: Latest mutually completed B boundary, full model/upper+lower Adam/RNG/240 environments per rank preserved before any diagnostic.

diagnostic.split: Fixed seeded split of whole (env,episode) trajectories, never randomly split decisions from one game.
diagnostic.repeatability: User clarified GPU floating-point differences need not be byte-identical. Keep exact source policy/Adam/RNG restoration. Compare fixed-probe outputs with explicit FP32 absolute and relative-L2 limits; report actual errors and exact-repeat flag separately. These output limits are numerical diagnostics, not evidence of policy improvement.

measurements: old-to-final complete categorical KL on fixed legal-action probes; single-legal-action and multi-action distributions separate, by phase and tails
unseen-whole-game clipped surrogate with frozen old advantages, reported as a diagnostic not achieved win-rate gain
old/new critic bias, MSE and explained variance against natural Monte Carlo returns on held-out whole games
actual actor/critic Adam counts, full sample reuse, update wall and process-tree CPU/RSS/Torch/VRAM/device GPU telemetry
numerical control-repeat probes with errors reported; exact original policy/Adam/lower/RNG restoration
selection: Reject nonfinite, failed source restoration, incomplete/censored games, cross-rank inconsistency or numerical-repeat differences exceeding explicit tolerances. Single fixed-cohort surrogate/MSE is reference evidence only; online common-wall learning and stability decide adoption.

online_confirmation.initialization: Identical verified boundary bundle, all optimizers/RNG/environments preserved, separate run identities, four ranks sequentially exclusive.
